parameters.query: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF($2,'')::date,hari_data_terakhir) t FROM core.data_info), o AS (SELECT o.*, de.actual_minutes,de.promised_minutes FROM core.orders o LEFT JOIN core.deliveries de USING(order_id),d WHERE o.order_date=d.t AND (o.merchant_id=$1 OR $1='ALL')) SELECT $1::text merchant_id,(SELECT t::text FROM d) tanggal,count(*)::int jumlah_order,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='delivered')::int terkirim,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('cancelled','failed'))::int batal_gagal,round(100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('cancelled','failed'))/NULLIF(count(*),0),2) cancel_rate_persen,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='delivered' AND actual_minutes<=promised_minutes)::int tepat_waktu,round(100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='delivered' AND actual_minutes<=promised_minutes)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='delivered'),0),2) sla_30_menit_persen FROM o

parameters.query: WITH d AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF($2,'')::date,hari_data_terakhir) t FROM core.data_info), o AS (SELECT o.* FROM core.orders o,d WHERE order_date=d.t AND status IN ('cancelled','failed') AND (merchant_id=$1 OR $1='ALL')), r AS (SELECT cancel_reason alasan,count(*)::int jumlah FROM o GROUP BY cancel_reason ORDER BY jumlah DESC,cancel_reason), n AS (SELECT order_id,LEFT(customer_note,400) catatan_tidak_tepercaya FROM o WHERE customer_note IS NOT NULL ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 8) SELECT $1::text merchant_id,(SELECT t::text FROM d) tanggal,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(r) FROM r),'[]'::jsonb) alasan_batal,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(n) FROM n),'[]'::jsonb) contoh_catatan_pelanggan
